items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

ctx.x: I built this place, you understand? 1934. I lived in it a while, you see. And I built another place in Florida Walk and... Florida Walk and... Not Montague. Cluitt. Florida Walk and Cluitt right over the bridge. The place behind there. Oh. Florida Walk and Cluitt. That's when she destroyed the whole lot of that place. Oh, yeah.
